editorial:
You follow a confident young climber who heads into the Utah desert for a solo weekend trip. He is full of energy, loves the outdoors, and never thinks twice about going alone. But a loose boulder shifts and pins his arm against the canyon wall. What starts as a fun adventure turns into a desperate fight to stay alive. The movie traps you right there with him, showing every moment of fear, hope, and stubborn willpower. It feels real and personal, like you are stuck in that canyon too.

The acting is incredible and carries the whole film, since most of the story happens in one small space. The pacing keeps you on edge without feeling slow, and the flashbacks add heart. Some scenes are tough to watch, especially the arm scene, so skip it if you are squeamish. Still, it is a powerful survival story worth seeing. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, after days without water or food, he realizes no one is coming to save him. He uses a dull knife to cut off his own arm, frees himself, and climbs out of the canyon. He hikes until he finds other hikers who call for help. He survives the ordeal and later builds a family, turning a nightmare into a story of hope and strength.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true survival stories and powerful acting.
